# Ferrum OS

> India-first construction & investment platform — land feasibility, AI
> design, structural checks, BOQ estimation, rate comparison, IRR/NPV
> modeling, CDE status. All figures across every tool are INDICATIVE
> unless explicitly stated otherwise — sample/illustrative data, not
> live government or market feeds, until noted.

Full machine-readable specs:
- OpenAPI (REST): /docs/api
- MCP server (Model Context Protocol): /mcp
- A2A agent card: /.well-known/agent.json

## Tools (available over both REST and MCP — same input/output shape)

- **ulpin-demo** — Indicative ULPIN parcel lookup. `GET /api/ulpin/:id`
- **testfit** — SVG massing/test-fit generation for a plot. `POST /api/testfit`
- **plan-gen** — STUB, not implemented. Returns 501. `POST /api/plan-gen`
- **is-check** — IS 456 Cl 26.5.1.1 (RC beam min reinforcement), IS 800 Cl 3.8 (steel column slenderness), IS 1893:2016 Cl 6.4.2 (seismic coefficient), IS 875:2015 Part 3 (wind pressure) checks. `POST /api/is-check`
- **boq-estimate** — Indicative bill-of-quantities estimate. `POST /api/boq-estimate`
- **rate-compare** — Indicative material/labor rate comparison. `GET /api/rates/compare`
- **irr-npv** — Investment IRR/NPV modeling from cash flows. `POST /api/irr-npv`
- **cde-status** — Indicative mock CDE project status (does not yet vary by project_id). `GET /api/cde-status/:project_id`

## Write path

- **leads** — Lead capture. `POST /api/leads`. No MCP tool by design —
  this is a human-CTA conversion action, not a general agent capability.

## Not agent-accessible

The site's human-facing workspace, auth, payments, and Transact
case-management features (accounts, saved artifacts, subscriptions,
document uploads) are separate from the tool surface above and are not
exposed as MCP tools or documented here — they require a logged-in
session and are out of scope for this file. See /.well-known/agent.json
for the authentication note on the tool surface itself (none required).

## Compliance

Every figure returned by any tool above is labeled `indicative: true`.
None of these tools issue a legal opinion, a guaranteed price, or a
government-verified value. See docs/COMPLIANCE_GATE.md in the source
repository for the full compliance posture.
